item.title: Supreme Court Declines Trump Appeal in Carroll Case
item.description: The Supreme Court refused to hear President Trump's attempt to overturn a jury's $5 million verdict finding him liable for sexual abuse and defamation of E. Jean Carroll.

item.title: Kushner advises Netanyahu to test Hamas disarmament in Gaza
item.description: On Monday, Jared Kushner, adviser to President Trump, suggested to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that the U.S. favors a gradual approach in Gaza.

item.title: Trump administration halts border wall work at Big Bend
item.description: Construction on the border wall at Big Bend National Park in Texas has been temporarily stopped by the Trump administration while the CBP commissioner reviews the project.

item.title: Midterm anti-establishment wave hits veteran Democrats
item.description: Longtime House Democrats are facing unexpected challenges as primary voters express discontent with the political establishment.
